INT. MIKE LEACH'S OFFICE - DAY

Mike Leach, the head coach of the Washington State Cougars, is sitting at his desk, analyzing game footage. His phone buzzes with a message from the PAC-12 conference. He reads it, his expression turning serious.

MIKE LEACH
(to himself)
Well, that's not the news we were hoping for.

Jerry, his assistant coach, enters the room, noticing Mike's change in demeanor.

JERRY
What's up, Mike? You look like you've seen a ghost.

MIKE LEACH
We've just received word from the PAC-12. Despite our strong season, we've been eliminated from Rose Bowl contention due to our loss against Washington and Oregon's victory over Utah.

Jerry looks disappointed but nods in understanding.

JERRY
That's a tough break, but we've had a great season nonetheless.

Mike Leach stands up, walking over to a large map of the United States on his wall. He points to the Rose Bowl in Pasadena, California.

MIKE LEACH
The Rose Bowl is a dream for every college football coach, but it's not the end of the world. We've got a lot to be proud of, and we'll come back even stronger next season.

FADE OUT.
